meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('important').

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.
Go on, tell her. Nina doesn't believe it.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you

examples.trans: Turn up the volume on the television, please.

examples.trans: I do everything exactly according to your order.

meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'кренность'). Abstract feminine noun formed with the Slavic suffix '-ость' ('-ness, -ity') from the corresponding adjective. Common feminine noun meaning 'sincerity, candidness' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: В твоих словах нет настоящей искренности.
examples.trans: In your words there is no real sincerity.

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'стоящий'). Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('real, genuine').

examples.text: Ваня, да пойми ты наконец! Это настоящий успех.
examples.trans: Vanya, understand at last! This is real success.

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('experienced').

examples.text: Слушай, Самсон, я тут подумал. Твой начальник — такой опытный специалист.
examples.trans: Listen, Samson, I've been thinking. Your boss is such an experienced specialist.

meanings.note: Prefix 'от-' ('away from, off') marks separation, completion, or response (stem 'личный'). Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('excellent').

examples.text: Квартира будет отличная. На Симашко есть новый дом.
examples.trans: It'll be an excellent flat. There's a new building on Simashko Street.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

examples.text: Послушайте, а можно в другое место? Здесь плохо пахнет.

examples.trans: There is this English chef. I will learn to cook from his shows.

повторить.gloss: to repeat, to go over again

meanings.en: to repeat, to say or do again
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторить'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to go over again', paired with 'повторять'.

examples.trans: Right, let's go over it again.
So, repeat that clearly once more.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'вторять'). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to repeat, to review', paired with 'повторить'.

examples.text: Ещё раз повторяю, я решил вашу проблему.
examples.trans: I repeat once again, I solved your problem.

examples.text: Каждый день ты повторяешь одно и то же.

examples.text: Экскаваторщик — это не мой уровень. Может, поможешь?

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (stem 'огласиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to agree', paired with 'соглашаться'.

examples.trans: Admit it / Don't you agree, that's much better.

examples.text: Это гораздо лучше, чем двенадцать лет. Согласитесь?
examples.trans: That's much better than twelve years. Don't you agree?

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.en: to hear, catch the sound of
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'слышать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to hear', paired with 'слышать'.

examples.trans: I am glad to hear that.
I just want to hear the truth.

meanings.en: to calm down, to settle down
meanings.note: Prefix 'у-' marks departure, removal, or successful completion (stem 'спокоиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to calm down', paired with 'успокаиваться'.

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.
